description: Get 9 personalized gift ideas for a specific person, each with a reason it fits and within the budget, plus one giftgenius.io link that opens the same ideas with photos and where to buy them. Pass every detail you already know about the recipient; only relationship, occasion and budget are required. Call again with "exclude" for more ideas, and with "feedback" (what the user said about the earlier ones) for ideas that follow it.

age.description: Recipient age in years, if known.

budget.description: Price per gift: under-25 (under $25), 25-50, 50-100, or 100-plus ($100+). Ideas come from this tier or cheaper.

description.description: The user's own description of the person, in their words, when they gave one, e.g. "my dad turns 62, golfs every Saturday and is always planning a house project". Read together with the other fields (max 600 characters).

exclude.description: Names of ideas already shown, to get 9 different ones. The most recent 45 are used.

feedback.description: What the user said about the ideas already shown, in their words, e.g. "he manages big house projects, he doesn't do them himself". The next ideas follow it. Used together with "exclude" (max 240 characters).

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests or hobbies, e.g. ["coffee", "gardening"]. An entry holding a comma-separated list is split into separate interests.

notes.description: Anything else that helps: personality, things they already own, what to avoid (max 400 characters).

occasion.description: The occasion. Use "Just because" if none fits.

occasion_name.description: The occasion in a few words when none of the listed ones names it, e.g. "a housewarming", "Valentine's Day", "her retirement" (max 40 characters).

recipient.description: The recipient in a few words when more specific than the relationship, e.g. "my girlfriend", "my niece", "my kid's teacher" (max 40 characters).

relationship.description: Who the gift is for. Map husband/wife/boyfriend/girlfriend to "Partner", son/daughter to "Kid", brother/sister to "Sibling", grandma/grandpa to "Grandparent", colleague to "Coworker"; otherwise "Someone else".

store.description: Limits every idea to one store: "amazon", or "etsy" for handmade, personalized and vintage things from small makers. Left out, the ideas are a mix of both.

name: find_gift_ideas

finder_url.description: The same search on giftgenius.io, for the user to refine or get more ideas.

on_sale.description: True when the Amazon product matched to this idea had a deal open to every shopper when this answer was made. Its price and deal are on list_url.

why.description: Why this recipient will love it, addressed to the giver.

list_url.description: These same ideas on giftgenius.io, with photos and where to buy each one.

title: Find gift ideas
